about_short_description.short_description: Docsum is a developer of an AI-based platform designed for contract review and negotiation.

product.name: AI Contract Review
product.description: An AI-powered tool that analyzes contracts to identify red flags, generate redlines, and provide comments based on configured playbooks.

product.name: Contract Repository
product.description: A centralized platform to store, organize, and extract key data from signed contracts for easy search, tracking, and reporting.

product.name: Contract Playbooks
product.description: Configurable rule sets that define how AI reviews contract clauses and generates redlines based on legal preferences and precedent language.

product.name: AI Document Editor
product.description: A DOCX-native editor for contract drafting, editing, redlining, and collaboration with AI-assisted clause modification and drafting.

product.name: Email Negotiation Agent
product.description: An email-based service that automatically marks up contracts with AI-generated redlines and comments according to configured playbooks, requiring no integration.
